verdict.rationale: Appwrite documents TablesDB with structured relational data, typed columns, relationships and indexes. It also offers a dedicated native PostgreSQL database you can connect to directly with psql, Prisma or Drizzle, which implies standard SQL relational querying. However, no evidence explicitly describes joins, constraint enforcement or transactions in either offering. Older community remarks that Postgres was not yet supported predate the current docs and do not concretely contradict them. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of join queries, constraint types (foreign keys, uniqueness), transaction APIs, and independent hands-on corroboration.
